nodes.name: App.jsx
nodes.summary: Application entry point that composes routing, shared UI layers, authentication transitions, and dashboard route fallbacks.

nodes.name: ERCVectorLogo.jsx
nodes.summary: Reusable, accessible SVG rendering of the Egyptian Red Crescent emblem for application branding and transitions.

nodes.name: Login.jsx
nodes.summary: Implements the interactive sign-in experience, including credential submission, additional verification flow, server-status feedback, and animated presentation controls.

nodes.name: motionAudit.test.js
nodes.summary: Node test suite auditing motion CSS ownership, reduced-motion behavior, route transitions, and key authentication-transition integration contracts.

nodes.name: serverHealthCore.test.js
nodes.summary: Node tests covering health-check classification, consecutive-failure thresholds, recovery detection, timeout handling, and endpoint response behavior.

nodes.name: CustomTooltipLayer.jsx
nodes.summary: Provides a portal-based tooltip layer that positions labels for pointer and keyboard focus while preserving native title and accessibility descriptions.

nodes.name: WorkingToast.jsx
nodes.summary: Renders the shared working-status toast in response to show and hide browser events.

nodes.name: AnimatedNumber.jsx
nodes.summary: Animates numeric display values with a spring while preserving formatting and rendering non-numeric text unchanged.

nodes.name: AuthEntryTransition.jsx
nodes.summary: Coordinates the branded sign-in and sign-out transition overlay, tracking transition phase, origin geometry, timers, and context actions.

nodes.name: primitives.jsx
nodes.summary: Defines reusable Framer Motion wrappers for global motion preferences, staggered entrances, and responsive drawer detection.

nodes.name: tokens.js
nodes.summary: Centralizes spring, easing, entrance, layout, and tactile-interaction presets shared by the interface motion system.

nodes.name: visualTransitions.js
nodes.summary: Wraps route or state updates with the browser View Transition API when available and schedules a single fallback when it is unsupported or fails.

nodes.name: serverHealth.jsx
nodes.summary: Provides the React health-monitoring hook and blocking recovery overlay, polling the server and translating health-core decisions into UI state.

nodes.name: serverHealthCore.js
nodes.summary: Implements the framework-independent health request, failure classification, and restart/recovery decision logic used by the watchdog and its tests.

nodes.name: workingToast.js
nodes.summary: Manages shared working-toast events and request lifecycle state, including manual controls and automatic handling for eligible fetch requests.

nodes.name: triggerPageTransition
nodes.summary: Starts and cleans up the dashboard surface CSS entrance animation, replacing any prior animation-end handler.

nodes.name: triggerLoginRouteFallback
nodes.summary: Applies the login route's CSS fallback entrance and removes its listener after the matching animation completes.

nodes.name: VisualTransitionFallback
nodes.summary: Observes route and dashboard navigation changes, avoids locale-only animations, and triggers CSS fallbacks when native snapshots do not own the transition.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: Composes the router, shared transition and status layers, lazy dashboard route, and sign-in route under motion preferences.

nodes.name: ERCVectorLogo
nodes.summary: Renders the crescent emblem as an SVG with configurable accessible labeling and decorative mode.

nodes.name: OpsClock
nodes.summary: Displays a locally updated clock while isolating its one-second refresh to the small clock component.

nodes.name: useCountUp
nodes.summary: Interpolates a target gauge value with requestAnimationFrame and returns the final value directly when reduced motion is preferred.

nodes.name: Gauge
nodes.summary: Renders a readiness percentage, animated fill bar, and label using the shared count-up behavior.

nodes.name: LampAssembly
nodes.summary: Implements the sign-in scene's interactive pull-cord lamp, including pointer parallax and spring-like cord return animation.

nodes.name: Login
nodes.summary: Manages the sign-in form, authentication and verification stages, server-health display, language/theme state, and animated landing scene.

nodes.name: installBrowserMock
nodes.summary: Installs controlled document, window, and transition API mocks and returns helpers for resolving transitions and restoring global state.

nodes.name: getPlacement
nodes.summary: Calculates tooltip side and viewport-constrained coordinates from its trigger geometry and text direction.

nodes.name: CustomTooltipLayer
nodes.summary: Tracks pointer and focus events, manages tooltip accessibility attributes, and portals the active tooltip into the document body.

nodes.name: WorkingToast
nodes.summary: Subscribes to shared working-state events and displays or clears the animated status pill accordingly.

nodes.name: parseDisplay
nodes.summary: Parses a display string into numeric value and formatting metadata, returning no animation metadata for unsupported text.

nodes.name: AnimatedNumber
nodes.summary: Uses a spring-driven value to animate numeric text while preserving prefix, suffix, grouping, decimal precision, and reduced-motion behavior.

nodes.name: AuthEntryTransitionProvider
nodes.summary: Owns the authentication transition context and coordinates source-logo measurement, route markers, timing, visual phases, and overlay rendering.

nodes.name: useAuthEntryTransition
nodes.summary: Returns the authentication-transition context and reports misuse outside its provider.

nodes.name: MotionProvider
nodes.summary: Configures shared Framer Motion defaults and delegates reduced-motion handling to the user's system preference.

nodes.name: StaggerGroup
nodes.summary: Wraps children in a motion container that distributes their entrance timing with configurable stagger and delay settings.

nodes.name: StaggerItem
nodes.summary: Wraps an item in a motion element and supplies the selected entrance variants for parent stagger groups.

nodes.name: useIsMobileDrawer
nodes.summary: Tracks a media query with a React state hook and cleans up its change listener across modern and legacy browser APIs.

nodes.name: staggerParent
nodes.summary: Creates hidden/show variants that configure child staggering and entrance delay.

nodes.name: scheduleFallback
nodes.summary: Clears the matching transition marker and dispatches a fallback event on the next animation frame or microtask.

nodes.name: runVisualTransition
nodes.summary: Runs an update once inside a native view transition when supported, otherwise runs it directly and schedules fallback behavior on transition failure.

nodes.name: useServerHealth
nodes.summary: Polls server health, classifies failures and recoveries, updates watchdog state, and manages active-tab and network-triggered checks.

nodes.name: ServerDownOverlay
nodes.summary: Renders the blocking outage or recovery interface from the watchdog's health and incident state.

nodes.name: healthUrl
nodes.summary: Builds the health endpoint URL with a timestamp query value to avoid stale cached responses.

nodes.name: checkServerHealth
nodes.summary: Sends a bounded-time health request and normalizes reachability, database status, response data, latency, and errors.

nodes.name: classifyHealth
nodes.summary: Classifies a health result, increments or clears the failure count, selects the failure reason, and determines whether the UI should block.

nodes.name: resolveRecovery
nodes.summary: Compares prior and current server identity metadata to identify restart versus recovery and create an expiring incident record.

nodes.name: setWorkingHardCap
nodes.summary: Sets a non-negative override for the working-session safety timeout, primarily for tests.

nodes.name: setWorkingSuppressed
nodes.summary: Enables or disables toast suppression and clears an active toast session when suppression is turned on.

nodes.name: showWorking
nodes.summary: Starts or increments a working session, broadcasts its display text, and resets the hard-cap safety timer.

nodes.name: hideWorking
nodes.summary: Decrements the active-session count and emits a hide event when no working operations remain.

nodes.name: resetWorking
nodes.summary: Clears all working-session state and timers, then broadcasts a hide event.

nodes.name: withWorking
nodes.summary: Wraps a promise or promise-producing function in a working session and hides the toast when it settles.

nodes.name: autoShow
nodes.summary: Starts automatic toast state for eligible requests while preserving an existing manually supplied working message.

nodes.name: autoSettle
nodes.summary: Schedules automatic toast dismissal after in-flight requests settle, honoring minimum display and grace periods.

nodes.name: installWorkingAuto
nodes.summary: Installs a guarded fetch wrapper that tracks eligible non-read requests and settles shared working status without altering request results.

nodes.name: getWorkingText
nodes.summary: Returns the currently stored working-status text.
